verdict.rationale: Viam documents an official CLI with a reference page. The CLI can call any API method a machine serves with JSON in and JSON out, and Viam explicitly positions it so an AI agent with a shell can operate machines. Further documented features include data SQL/MQL queries and shell completion. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The CLI can call any API method a machine serves, with JSON in and JSON out. That makes it a complete way to operate a machine from a shell
An AI agent with a shell or an SDK can operate a Viam machine the same way a person or a program can.
viam data query tabular sql --org-id=<org-id> --sql=<query> [--destination=<output path>]
The completion command outputs a shell completion script. Load the output in your shell to enable tab completion for commands, subcommands, and flag names.
